tests.name: Anonymous requests cannot access servers
Foreign server and deployment status both return 403
Owners can edit identification but cannot change resources or executable startup
Cartridge creation rejects invalid limits before provisioning
Memory uses exact 64-bit limits; CPU, pids and root filesystem are constrained
Unenrolled, plaintext, credential-bearing and path-bearing Docker origins are rejected
Enrolled node is reachable with mutual TLS
Mutual TLS rejects missing client credentials, wrong CAs and wrong hostnames
Timed-out TLS handshakes close the underlying connection
Images require exact approval and data quotas fail closed
Provisioning sends finite memory and a quota-controlled home volume
Power requests use the server's own node
Legacy images fail before any volume or container is created
All creation flows enforce finite node capacity and reserve ports
Console sends stdin only; no Docker exec or shell is used
Container ownership labels are checked before operations
Logs reject unlimited tails and enforce a byte ceiling
Pagination is mandatory and allocation batches are bounded
Suspension defeats an in-flight power action and stale status write
Reservation concurrency tokens prevent stale capacity writes
An invitation with one use creates at most one account
Authentication needs no ambient cookies or stale antiforgery token
Invite creation is bounded, expires by default and revocation defeats a stale consumer
Expired sessions and tampered JWTs are rejected
Changing a password revokes the old JWT immediately
Logout revokes the current session on the server
Inactive accounts and changed roles invalidate signed tokens
Authentication limits are per IP and ignore spoofed forwarding headers
